non_public_module_classifications.rationale: Underscore-prefixed symbols remain private/internal despite existing tests; later gates may migrate tests to canonical public contracts before removal.
ProviderVerifierAdapter is an app adapter implementation of the provider-verifier port; the adapter class is importable for wiring/tests but is not an external public compatibility facade.
Application ports are explicit internal service contracts for app-service wiring. They may be imported by tests and implementations, but they are not external user/package compatibility facades.

Application services are internal use-case boundaries. Their public names are stable execution inputs for later gates, but this inventory does not classify them as external public import compatibility.

non_public_module_classifications.surface: vNext schema, resolved DTO, and runtime resolution modules
non_public_module_classifications.rationale: These modules are schema values, resolved DTOs, and runtime-resolution contracts used inside the vNext architecture. They are not legacy implementation owners and are not external compatibility facades.

non_public_module_classifications.surface: core lifecycle, observability, error-message, telemetry, and metadata contract modules
non_public_module_classifications.rationale: These modules expose internal core contracts for lifecycle, diagnostics, safe error/message shaping, telemetry ports/services, and OpenRouter metadata. They are not external public compatibility facades.
Provider error-detail helpers redact and extract safe diagnostic fragments for LLM adapters. They are internal implementation contracts, not external public compatibility facades.

The local decode coordinator owns provider-internal FIFO inference scheduling and lifecycle behavior. It is shared implementation infrastructure for local STT adapters, not an external public compatibility facade.

Output modules define internal output/message ports and routing implementation. The package-level OutputRouter re-export remains inventoried as public; submodules are classified internal unless separately inventoried.

Runtime-owner modules are internal ownership boundaries for runtime-only state and tasks. The lazy core.runtime facade remains inventoried as public; concrete owner modules are internal unless separately inventoried.
OpenVR vendoring helpers support packaging/native overlay startup compatibility but are not the public overlay protocol, startup, manifest, or snapshot contract.
Non-private UI module names are app-internal renderer structure, not external import compatibility, unless separately added to public_imports.
Event mapping and projection modules are internal Gate 4 UI/application boundary contracts. The inventoried public import path remains puripuly_heart.ui.event_bridge unless separately approved.
Orchestrator internals are not public compatibility facades; public behavior is preserved through runtime/message/output contracts and tests.

non_public_module_classifications.surface: puripuly_heart.core.audio, core.osc, core.stt, and core.vad implementation modules not listed in public_imports
non_public_module_classifications.rationale: These non-private modules are classified as implementation support unless an explicit __all__, existing public test import, packaging import, documented entry point, or approved facade appears in public_imports.
Broker /v1 paths, envelopes, public error codes, and classes are public compatibility; Cloudflare worker internals are not public Python import surfaces.
Overlay startup/protocol/snapshot compatibility and Rust startup behavior are public compatibility; Rust module layout remains private implementation.
